frequency_boundary.confirmed: The CAIManager update is invoked once from each completed CDailyTickCommand final stage. Each traversed raw owner route can call 0x18D2560 once, and each passing 0x18D2560 invocation calls producer 0x1921810 exactly once.

minimum_next_live_plan.purpose: exercise exactly one natural daily CAIManager pass without forcing the producer, effect, GUI, or construction action
precondition: fresh userdir and immutable R687 source checkpoint
exact-build and private observer preflight GREEN
paused map-ready application-main frame bound to the expected player and episode
persist the raw observer heartbeat before semantic validation

control.daily_sentinel: arm the existing production-live tactical_daily_sentinel_v1 for target_date_raw = start_date_raw + 0x18 in date-only terminal mode

terminal_classification.GREEN: producer_calls >= 1, accepted_captures >= 1, failure_flags == 0, capture_read_failures == 0, exact +1-day sentinel stop, unchanged source and target save
terminal_classification.RED: producer_calls >= 1 but no accepted capture, any observer/admission/read failure, date overshoot, duplicate CK3, unexpected input/action/save mutation, or cleanup failure
terminal_classification.BOUNDED_NO_GO: exactly one completed daily final stage with producer_calls == 0 and otherwise clean evidence

minimum_next_live_plan.no_go_followup: Do not extend or retry the same round. A clean zero after one completed daily stage means the checkpoint had no passing raw owner route that day; the next static step is a private entry/gate-mask observer, not a longer passive wait.

observer_decision.reason: The hook is on the only normal-runtime direct producer call and lies inside the daily CAIManager route used during ordinary running play. R687 did not exercise a daily tick, so it does not justify replacing the hook.
observer_decision.conditional_fallback: Only after a one-day final-stage transaction still yields zero producer calls, add a default-OFF private observer at 0x18D2560 entry that records a bounded raw gate mask and never calls the producer or mutates game state.
